scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional assertions have an analytic proof. Separate exact rational Ehrhart enumeration corroborates finitely many examples, not the universal proof. No authorship or independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two-level ultrametrics with all cross-cluster distances one; common-radius strict majorization only for 0<t<1; asymptotic with fixed k and t. No conclusion for deeper ultrametric hierarchies or primal Mahler products. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a residual risk.
title: Exact clustered-ultrametric Lipschitz-ball volumes and a strict balancing law
